swing.animationDescription: a chop: the hand axe turns about the bottom end of its handle, which stays in place, from pointing up and to the right, through pointing straight ahead to the right, to pointing down and to the right; the same axe the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail

replaced.description: the hand axe swings in a short chopping arc: tilted back and up, then swung forward and down to the right until the handle points ahead, then on down, the same axe the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Turned about its head, not the hand, and swung backwards on frames 3 and 4.

replaced.description: a chop seen from the side: the axe is held by the bottom end of its handle, which stays at the same spot in every frame; the head starts raised high above, then swings forward and down to the right in an arc until the handle points straight ahead to the right, then a little further down; the same axe the whole time, no particles, no effects, no motion trail
replaced.why: Made again in the same group (replace_existing): turned about the hand but only rocked up and back, never forward.
